source.notes: Nominal dimensions manually checked against user-supplied Nunc MicroWell plate F96 Straight plate drawing 2817 version 10 (valid from 2007-05-31). Source URL identifies the product; the dimensional source is the named, hashed PDF. A1 y = 85.48 - 11.3 (bottom edge to H row) - 7*9 = 11.18 mm. A1 x = 14.3 mm. 6.97 mm is the inner opening diameter; 6.17 mm is the inner bottom diameter; 8.4 mm is the outer well diameter. Outer corners/chamfers and molded features are simplified to a rectangular footprint, not inferred from image scale. See docs/nunc-96.md for callouts, tolerances and derivations.
